title: Plan did not specify stub-update prerequisites before parallel wave execution
description: plan_phase_epic identified that CurrentUser stub was missing `rights` and `visibility_profile` fields and that RabbitMQ publish() was missing `headers` parameter, but listed these as gap findings rather than as explicit prerequisite steps that must happen BEFORE Wave 1 starts. Without pre-wave stub updates, parallel swarm workers cannot implement or test against the correct interface contracts.
root_cause: plan_phase_epic treats stub mismatches as informational notes in the Gap Analysis section rather than as blocking prerequisites that must be resolved before parallel execution can begin. The command lacks a 'pre-wave prerequisites' concept in its parallelization strategy.
recommendation: When plan_phase_epic detects that bootstrap stubs do not match the plan's interface contracts, it should generate an explicit 'Pre-Wave Prerequisites' section in the Parallelization Strategy that lists specific stub updates (file, change, rationale) that must be completed before Wave 1 begins. This ensures swarm workers start with correct interface contracts.
affected_section: Parallelization Strategy generation in plan_phase_epic.md — the section that creates execution waves.
plan_context: Infrastructure Foundation epic with 12 bootstrap stubs and 5 parallel components
